actions.text: This is an important and timely framework. As an ML engineer, I welcome clearer risk-based rules that hold developers and deployers accountable for high-risk systems, while still preserving space for innovation. My hope is regulators will pair technical standards with practical guidance and phased compliance timelines so smaller teams can meet requirements without stalling beneficial research and products. Ultimately, robust transparency and independent testing will build public trust and help companies adopt safer AI responsibly. — Jordan Mitchell
